text: {"score":3,"justification":"Most numbers match the card and the lean (inconclusive) and the next steps are reasonable. But several narrative claims are unsupported or wrong, and some text contradicts the card. An investigator would have to recheck parts of it.","problems":["Headline says 99215 is far above expectation \"across every complexity band except 5+\", but the 3-condition band (0.211 vs 0.072) is the only one fully consistent; the claim is fine, yet the summary's later line that the 5+ share is \"at or below the all-provider rate\" (0.179 vs 0.207) is correct but the inference that this is the \"opposite of what a sicker panel would show\" is speculative interpretation.","Describes C0312390 as \"rash\" but the dx is R21 and the card gives no description; R21 being a rash is an outside inference, though accurate in ICD terms. C0312408 \"UTI\" (N39.0) is likewise inferred. Z09 is labelled \"follow-up\", which is acceptable.","Says these \"look like routine visits billed at the highest level\" — strong, not supported by the card, which has only diagnosis codes and condition counts, and conflicts with the summary's own inconclusive lean.","Claims 5 of 15 notes with no lab line are \"weak evidence that notes may be templated or inflated\" — a stretch; absence of a lab line on the claim does not suggest templating.","Cites C0312901 as a low-complexity claim whose documentation supported the billed level: true per the card, but the \"rule check deems this too few to judge\" statement is not traceable to the card or tool outputs.","Next steps in the structured field are generic (larger sample of 99214/99215) and do not name the specific low-complexity claims, though the rationale does; the rationale and next_steps are partly redundant and inconsistent.","The 9% comparison rate for documented 99215 below billed (card 0.087) is fine, but the summary does not note that none of the 19 documented claims were below billed at any level, and the documented sample is only 3.8% of claims.","The cited_claim_ids list only two claims, while the text refers to many more (C0312408, C0312575, C0312802, C0312641, C0312901); C0312405 is cited only in the boilerplate example, with no point depending on it."]}
